'# c\nSHOW TABLES' -> stripped as comment under None and mysql -> True; under postgres '#' is not a comment (correct), so it is not a leading-comment case; the parse-root fallback at 169-172 handles SHOW otherwise. Unterminated '/* SHOW TABLES' -> returns '' (118), keyword check false; it is not a SHOW statement behind a comment (the whole text is an unclosed comment), so the claim is not contradicted. Criteria file read; it is a list of {criterion,text} objects and carries criterion 6, so it counts. query_database.py:290-291 passes dialect=sqlglot_dialect_for_url(cfg.database.url) into components_to_blocks. _format.py:429-431 classifies each run_sql card's SQL with is_introspection_query(sql, dialect=dialect) and caches it in last_sql_is_introspection. _format.py:436 clears error_message only when status == 'success' and is_run_sql and not last_sql_is_introspection, so an introspection success never clears (the clear is at 449-454).
